title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Saturday, 3 October 2026
description: Today's stories: Anthropic's faster, cheaper Claude Sonnet 5.5 release, daylight saving starting this weekend alongside a Victorian flood watch after record dry conditions, Queensland stripping councils of data centre approval powers, and oversized bluebottles washing up on Gold Coast beaches ahead of tonight's SIX60 show at BLEACH Festival. 오늘의 브리핑은 영어에 이어 한국어로도 제공됩니다.
